query: Evaluating a 64‑year‑old woman: among female ICU patients aged 59–69 with a shock diagnosis versus without shock, in the first 24 hours what are mean and percentiles of composite instability score, hypotension (MAP<65) and tachycardia burden, ICU LOS, and mortality?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, CAST(p.anchor_year AS INT) AS age, s.shock, AVG(c.composite_instability_score) AS avg_composite_instability_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.composite_instability_score) AS percentile_25_composite_instability_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.composite_instability_score) AS percentile_75_composite_instability_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.hypotension = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_hypotension, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.tachycardia = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS num_tachycardia, AVG(s.los) AS avg_los, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_mortality FROM patients p JOIN icustays s ON p.subject_id = s.subject_id AND p.hadm_id = s.hadm_id JOIN chartevents c ON p.subject_id = c.subject_id AND p.hadm_id = c.hadm_id AND c.charttime BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND CAST(p.anchor_year AS INT) BETWEEN 59 AND 69 AND s.shock IS NOT NULL AND c.itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_items WHERE category = 'Composite Instability Score') GROUP BY p.gender, age, s.shock;
